pages._text: Noor sets the seed in the bed. Down it sinks. Soil settles around it. What comes after that?
Water runs over the spot. The can tips low. Again it flows. Does it reach the seed?
Morning comes. Noor tips the can once more. Water soaks in. What follows the water?
Noor presses both hands down. The soil shifts under them. Press and lift. Does the press change anything?
Noor presses the same place again. Hands move in the same way. Press and lift. What will the soil show?
Thin lines mark the soil near the seed. Noor follows one with a finger. Press and lift. What will push through next?
A thin green tip lifts the soil. It rises where the hands pressed. Noor watches it move. What stands in the garden now?
The green tip stands where pressed. Noor rests a hand beside it. The garden holds it steady.
